---
title: "A little help to get started"
---

## Your library, in your pocket

1. **Choose a book.** Visit the [library](bookshelfug.qmd) and tap **Start reading**.
2. **Find your topic.** Use the book’s chapter menu. On a phone, look for the menu button near the top of the page.
3. **Keep your place.** Bookmark the chapter in your browser so you can return to it.
4. **Practise as you read.** Work through an example before moving to the next topic.

## Studying R

Start with the foundations in [R Programming for Agricultural Data Analysis](r-textbook.html). Read the explanation, inspect the example and try changing one thing at a time. Browser laboratories need an internet connection and may take a moment to load. A laptop is useful for longer coding sessions; your phone is useful for reading and revision.

## Make reading comfortable

- Turn your phone sideways when a wide table or code example needs more room.
- Use your browser’s text-size or zoom settings to make the text comfortable.
- Save chapter bookmarks rather than relying on an open tab.
- Online books need a connection. Download a practical only when the book provides a download link.

## Course notes and passcodes

The books linked in this library are open to read. If your teacher shares a separate course resource with a passcode, use the link and code supplied by that teacher.

## Something not working?

[Contact the department](about.qmd#contact) with the book name, chapter and a short description of the problem. Include your browser and phone model if possible.
